title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow-improvements
author: Emilie Chen
description:
Motivation: Improve the unified rollouts autorollback workflow to reduce noisy false-positive rollbacks and improve observability for canary / A/B / shadow paths. This PR consolidates several safety guards, extends metric matching logic, and adds operational signals to the control plane to make rollback decisions more robust.

Summary of changes: - Add composite-metric quorum and time-window smoothing for rollback decisions. - Add staged probing support to quarantine probing stage without impacting live canary traffic. - Improve metric matching between shadow and canary to use normalized deltas and roll-call quorum across regions. - Expose new observability metrics and traces to track decision inputs. - Add E2E tests and integration test harness for simulated degraded-model scenarios.

Checklist: - [x] Core autorollback engine changes completed - [x] Unit + integration tests added - [x] Observability dashboards updated - [x] Docs updated (operator guide) - [x] Manual QA in staging with canary scenarios

Testing notes: Ran unit tests (all pass), integration tests against local simulator with 10k simulated requests, and e2e canary rollback scenario in staging (triggered and recovered as expected). One flaky e2e test required a minor timing guard fix which was included.

Migration/compatibility: Changes are additive to the rollout policy schema. Default behavior remains unchanged unless operators opt into the new composite_quorum or staged_probing flags. Backwards compatible with existing rollout specs.

Operational notes: New metrics require an update to the rollout observability dashboard (see observability/README). Recommend enabling the new safety guards on a subset of models for 24-48 hours and monitoring the composite_rollback_score and quorum_breakdown metrics before full rollout.

diff_snippets:
--- a/rollouts/core/autorollback_engine.py
+++ b/rollouts/core/autorollback_engine.py
@@
- if metric.delta > threshold:
-     trigger_rollback()
+ # compute normalized delta and quorum before triggering
+ composite_score = composite_quorum.evaluate(metrics_window)
+ if composite_score >= config.rollback_threshold:
+     trigger_rollback(reason="composite_quorum")

--- a/rollouts/workflows/canary_workflow.py
+++ b/rollouts/workflows/canary_workflow.py
@@
- def handle_response(resp):
+ def handle_response(resp):
      # attach shadow match score for observability
+     resp.meta['shadow_match_score'] = matcher.score(resp, shadow_reference)
      process(resp)

--- a/rollouts/workflows/staged_probing.py
+++ b/rollouts/workflows/staged_probing.py
@@
+class QuarantineStage:
+    def __init__(self, duration):
+        self.duration = duration
+    def enter(self, rollout):
+        rollout.pause_production_forwarding()
review_comments: Aisha Patel: Could you clarify how composite_quorum weights region-level signals? In multi-region deployments we want to avoid a single noisy region causing a global rollback.
Emilie Chen: Composite quorum aggregates by region with a per-region quorum and then computes a weighted sum. Added comments and unit tests (see b2f7e3a) to document weighting behavior.
Marco Diaz: Add more observability hooks so SRE can see the decision inputs for each rollback event. Also suggest exposing the raw windowed metrics for 60/5m windows.
Emilie Chen: Added rollback_metrics.go with composite_rollback_score, quorum_breakdown and windowed_metrics_{60m,5m}. Dashboard updated in observability/dashboards/rollouts_overview.json.
Lena Thompson: Tests look good; one minor nits on naming (time_window -> window_seconds). Can you address?
Emilie Chen: Renamed time_window to window_seconds and adjusted tests. Thanks for the catch.
Rakesh Menon: Integration tests passed in my staging run. Approving once CI is green.
merge_commit_message:
squash: unified-rollouts: improve autorollback workflow with composite quorum, staged probing, and observability

Adds composite metric quorum, staging quarantine for probing, new observability metrics, e2e tests and operator docs.
release_notes: Operator-facing: Adds optional composite_quorum and staged_probing flags to rollout policies. New metrics: composite_rollback_score, quorum_breakdown, windowed_metrics_60m, windowed_metrics_5m. Recommend canarying these settings in staging before turning on cluster-wide.
observability_changes: Updated rollouts_overview dashboard to include decision inputs
notes: This PR was driven by ENG-2042 (reduce spurious rollbacks) and ENG-2107 (improve rollout observability). Ops should watch composite_rollback_score during ramp. Rollout is gated behind feature flag rollout.experimental_composite_quorum.
e2e_results_summary: Simulated degraded-model run: rollback triggered at expected thresholds, quarantine stage quarantined probing traffic for 10m and allowed manual override. No production requests affected during staging run.
post_merge_actions: Enable feature flag rollout.experimental_composite_quorum for 10% of models in staging
Monitor composite_rollback_score and quorum_breakdown for 48 hours
Schedule runbook update and a 1-hour training for on-call SREs
